title: Percent problems: discounts and sale prices

blocks.content: Shops love percents. A discount is a percent taken off a price. Working out the discount, then the new price, is a two-step skill.
A discount is a percent OF the original price. Find it just like any percent of an amount.

blocks.prompt: A $50 item has 10% off. The discount is $___
blocks.explain: 10% of $50 is $5, so the discount is $5.
blocks.rule: A discount is a percent of the original price.

blocks.content: To get the sale price, subtract the discount from the original price.

blocks.prompt: A $50 item with a $5 discount now costs $___
blocks.rule: Subtract the discount from the original price to get the sale price.

blocks.content: Find the discount as a percent of the price, then subtract it. Two steps to any sale price. Let's practise!
